title: Signature Courage Bell
concept: A bell rung after the final treatment, with the patient's name engraved on a ribbon hung in the hallway of survivors. Every new patient walks past proof of finishing. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on quiet discharges with a celebrated, permanent milestone ritual.
equipment: Biological safety cabinets for chemo mixing
patient_flow: Diagnosis starts with biopsy and staging scans, then the tumor board — surgeons, oncologists, radiologists, pathologists — agrees on a plan. Treatment runs in cycles: infusion days, rest weeks, re-scans. Inpatient stays handle complications like neutropenic fever. Survivorship clinics follow patients for years after treatment ends.
code_demo:
# Signature Courage Bell — Signature design prototype
def chemo_bsa_dose(height_cm, weight_kg, mg_per_m2):
    """Body-surface-area chemo dose via Mosteller formula."""
    bsa = ((height_cm * weight_kg) / 3600) ** 0.5
    return f"BSA {bsa:.2f} m2 -> dose {round(bsa*mg_per_m2,1)} mg"
print(chemo_bsa_dose(170, 70, 100))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
